limitations: Full169 grid retained but itself evolved in earlier retrospective research
Many correlated basket/config searches; no search-adjusted significance claim
Historical liquidity is quote volume not executable spread/orderbookcapacity
Theoretical spotshorts; borrow/funding/margin/entitlements and realisticfills omitted
Dollar neutrality is not beta neutrality
Historicallist avoids current-survivor selection but source/lifecycle assumptions retained

metric_scope.daily_risk_basis: complete contiguous 24-hour UTC days from original saved path; boundary partial days excluded only from daily statistics
metric_scope.dd_underwater_time_convention: elapsed interval duration classified by ending observed drawdown
metric_scope.full_performance_basis: every requested hourly interval including opening/closing partial days, entry and terminal liquidation
metric_scope.turnover_convention: supplied full-L1 target changes including entry/liquidation; not drift-adjusted actual notional/NAV
metric_scope.ulcer_time_basis: full requested elapsed hours, observed endpoint drawdowns
